_comment: The mixed case panel 2 must not render green over. Artifact carries uid, so its merged
feature column arrives and both of its cells are judged clean: judged is positive and
nothing is skipped, which is what used to be enough for the plain green banner.
Collection below is the other half.
Collection carries no uid, so lamin_api._apply_merge returns the frame unchanged and the
feature it was asked to merge reaches no column. Nothing here was judged, and neither the
banner nor this registry's own heading may read as though it was.
